## Design

### 2026-11-06: I started the week planning on building a 4x4x4 cube of purple LEDs. I went looking online to get inspiration from others and found people doing it with 4 pinned RGB LEDs and I thought that would be c

**3h**

I started the week planning on building a 4x4x4 cube of purple LEDs. I went looking online to get inspiration from others and found people doing it with 4 pinned RGB LEDs and I thought that would be cool. I started laying out the schematic but as I was researching how to control it, I realized how complicated it would be having 3 inputs for each LED.

So now I am moving back to just 1 color LEDs. I've looked around for nice purple ones but haven't had much luck so I will probably end up going with blue. I then researched how to control the matrix and I decided to use a Xiao ESP32-C3, two 74HC595 shift registers, and 4 PN2222 transistors. This will allow me to encode 16 bits into the shift registers using 1 GIOP, then select the layer with the transistors, and then dump the data to the LEDs.

I will be sourcing the shift registers and transistors from Adafruit.

### 2026-11-10: I finished designing the schematic for my matrix. I went to start coding and realized that I don't know how a shift register works, so I spent some time looking that up and found an awesome guide. The

**1h**

I finished designing the schematic for my matrix. I went to start coding and realized that I don't know how a shift register works, so I spent some time looking that up and found an awesome guide. Then I started working on some test code for my esp32 dev board to check that I can read binary from a separate file.

After some trouble shooting and using the wrong pins, I was able to get it running so now I just have to wait to get the components so I can implement the final tests. Tomorrow I plan to start working on a simple program to visually create animations easily and then encode it into a .bin file for me to upload. This way I can make new animations easily.
